verdict.rationale: Remote documents a broad API. It covers two-way sync of people, contracts and payroll inputs, a single employment-creation endpoint for all employment types, and white-label embedding of Remote workflows in partner UIs. A CLI also manages departments, custom fields and webhooks. Nowhere is there an explicit claim or proof that every UI action has an API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API-UI parity statement or coverage matrix, a public OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), and independent confirmation that admin/settings actions are API-reachable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: push people, contracts, and payroll inputs into Remote, or pull workforce and payroll data out to your systems — sync goes both ways.
become a white-label partner and surface Remote workflows inside your own UI for your users.
All employment types are created through the same endpoint — `POST /v1/employments`
no dashboard step needed for this path
manage departments, custom fields, and webhook subscriptions, including delivery history and replays.
